Round33 mechanism: Winsorize gradient_magnitude_loss and laplacian_hf_loss at 95th percentile to redirect capacity from structural defects to clean regions.
Round33 is the first line since R30 to achieve external improvement on the main 0.8px battlefield.
Round31 measured external compare is formalized and does not change the baseline.
Round32 internal winner r32_real_eq_finetune completed external compare and failed; it cannot be promoted.

R26NewPSFCheck sandbox launched 2026-03-26: PSF policy switched 2026-03-27. External GMF for R26NewPSFCheck is still pending.
PSF policy: new Whole-FOV PSF is the current standard (2026-03-27); old PSF is the legacy empirical baseline.
R33 lag-1 autocorrelation is -0.55 (R30 was +0.27); step oscillation pattern noted but does not affect step_std target.
R33 TRADE-OFF: visual sharpness regressed (gradient -32%, steepness -22%, contrast -43%) while GMF step_std improved -29%.
R34 (freq-split), R35 (alpha-boost), R37 (freq-reg), R38 (seq-all-stages), R33c (contrast-fix) all FAILED to recover sharpness.
R38v2 (8px-only seq + signal gate 0.002 + warmup 15 epochs) PASSED external GMF (2026-04-07): 0.8px 0.134 (-20%), 8px 0.144 (-30%), 0.08px 0.106 (-33%).
R38v2 is the BALANCED candidate: GMF -20% with near-R30 visual quality (steepness +89%, contrast -13%). R33 remains GMF-EXTREME: -29% but steepness -22%.
R38v2 success factors: warmup preserves encoder sharpness, signal gate removes noise from weak-delta stages, 8px-only provides clean consistency signal.
Three production candidates: R33 p95 (GMF extreme), R38v2 8px_gate (visual priority), COMBO r38v2_8px_gate_p95 (most balanced).

COMBO (2026-04-08): Winsorize p95 + seq 8px gate + warmup. External 0.8px 0.132 (-22%), steepness +89%, residual_std all-time best. Beats R38v2 on 0.8px (0.132 vs 0.134) while maintaining same visual quality.
QUANTIZATION FIX (2026-04-08): denormalize_to_dtype changed from truncation to np.rint (rounding). Impact varies by model:
R33 quantfix: 0.8px 0.119->0.117 (-1.7% improved), 8px 0.153->0.172 (outliers 2->0, actually more robust), 0.08px 0.086->0.086 (-0.7%).
R38v2 quantfix: 0.8px 0.134->0.147 (+9.3% regressed, steep edges sensitive to quantization), 8px 0.144->0.122 (-15.3% improved).
Quantization fix is mathematically correct but affects edgel detection differently per model. Steep edges (R38v2) are more sensitive to +1 grey level shift.

Full series report: Experiments/R33RobustLoss/reports/R33_R38v2_COMPLETE_EXPERIMENT_SERIES.md

INTERNAL-EXTERNAL DIVERGENCE (2026-04-08): Internal step_std systematically overestimates external GMF. Ratio grows from 1.22 (R30) to 1.35 (COMBO) as model quality improves. Root cause: circle-fit noise floor (~0.17 px) dominates internal when real step variance < 0.15 px. Internal step_std is NO LONGER a reliable hard gate for candidates with residual_std < 2.5. Analysis: Experiments/R33RobustLoss/reports/INTERNAL_EXTERNAL_DIVERGENCE_ANALYSIS.md

ACTION ITEM: Improve internal measurement — increase angular sampling (360->720+) and/or implement weighted circle fit to lower noise floor. Current circle-fit precision is the bottleneck, not model quality.
